messages.subject: Unique Engineering | Mass transit, public works and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Unique Engineering Leadership Team,

Unique's portfolio across mass transit, roads, bridges, tunnels and public utility works makes stakeholder execution central to project success.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a large industrial operation.

I routinely manage formal approvals, regulator interfaces, community priorities and cross-functional action tracking. I also support renewable-energy and carbon-governance initiatives, adding a broader sustainability perspective to major-project stakeholder management.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Unique Engineering-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
